text.p: These are the leading stories in the Skopje press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified them nor does it vouch for their accuracy.

- The electoral campaign in Macedonia is warming up. Central party rallies to be held in Skopje on Wednesday and Thursday. Tensions between the parties resulted in several fights among rival supporters.
- Skopje airport to reopen on December 6 following a reconstruciton of its runway and signaling system.
- The Macedonian academy of arts and sciences organising a symposium on national strategy and economic development grouping 14 foreign experts. Symposium starts in Ohrid on Thursday.
- Japanese government donates $650,000 for Macedonian hospitals. Negotiations underway in the health ministry for an additional donation of five million dollars for the Skopje city hospital.
- Macedonian and Yugoslav expert teams are negotiating rules and details of a welfare and pensions agreement.
